name: skillmem
description: Procedural memory for Claude Code: not facts about you, but how a task was solved — trigger, steps, outcome, lessons. Hooks recall it before a task and record it after, so skills compound instead of being retyped. Nine MCP tools, local SQLite with optional on-device embeddings, nothing leaves the machine. Every memory carries its provenance, and what an agent writes stays data until you approve it at a terminal. Requires the skillmem package (pip install skillmem).
